comment: The dusk bat (BNpcBase 363) Where There Is Smoke (756) brings out (layout 4279981): level 25, 594 HP. Retail's auto-attacked for 22-24 every 3 s and used 55 once on itself; it also used 475 (32 on the player) and 57 (healed itself 181; Kawari's 57 heals a pugilist's fixed 52, so it isn't used here), once each. From Bob's Chronofoil capture 9df4ff01 (2026-10-30, Eastern Thanalan, `questkit chronofoil --battle 0.13`): `players` is the median damage to the player (level 25), `every` the time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
